import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic
import Mathlib.Tuple.Basic

def DivisionFunction (x : Nat) (y : Nat) : (Int × Int) :=
  if y = 0 then (Int.ofNat x, 0) else (x / y, x % y)

theorem DivisionFunction_spec_satisfied (x : Nat) (y : Nat) :
  DivisionFunction_spec_satisfied (x) (y) (DivisionFunction (x) (y)) h_precond := by
  apply h_precond
